main_body: A three-tier shelf stand in grey stone or metal. Each tier is a thin grey ledge carrying small candles, and a dark frame with a base plinth sits below.
top_band: At rows 14-15 there is a light grey line about 1-2 rows tall, with a mid-grey row under it. The lower tiers repeat this at about rows 19-20 and 24-25. None of them reads as a horizontal surface.
evidence: Each tier is only a 1-2px light ledge edge over a thin darker strip, which is the rim-only failure. The shelves are seen edge-on, so no surface is visible from above. The candles stand on a line instead of on a surface with depth. The frame below is a plain dark front elevation with no recessed shelf faces or eave shadow.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 2-3 grey steps on the ledges. The candles use a few cream and orange pixels, with no grain or per-material ramp. The dark frame is a flat, near-neutral fill. It looks much thinner than the stall and well references, which have 5-6 step ramps, grain and tinted outlines. Tiles are mostly 2-4 colours.
